title: Lead Quality Engineer (Test Automation & Transformation)
description:
About 8 West Consulting

8 West Consulting provides consultancy services and software solutions to clients across the US, Europe and the UK. We work in sectors including insurance, healthcare and retail, helping organisations tackle complex technology challenges and modernise critical platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Quality Engineer to advance test automation and AI-enabled quality engineering across enterprise client teams. You will establish pragmatic technical direction, help several projects adopt repeatable practices and lead improvements to testing capability, while personally delivering automation, dependable test data and quality support on live engagements.

This is not a strategy-only or people-management role. You will lead by building, demonstrating and coaching, helping teams move from manual-heavy testing towards reliable automation. The challenge is to make progress across established applications and different project needs, within enterprise controls and ongoing client commitments.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-team transformation. Assess testing maturity across enterprise teams, prioritise common opportunities and lead phased adoption of automation, AI-assisted testing and better data practices.
  • Stay hands-on. Personally write and debug UI, API, integration and data tests; solve difficult automation problems, investigate defects and support releases.
  • Set technical direction. Define pragmatic quality engineering principles, review solutions and guide tool choices across projects while allowing for different client architectures and constraints.
  • Build shared test data capability. Design and implement reusable builders, fixtures, seeding and reset patterns for complex systems; enable independent tests across teams and environments.
  • Scale AI-enabled testing. Implement AI-assisted test design, case and script generation, synthetic data creation and failure analysis, then establish validation, safe-use practices and repeatable adoption.
  • Create reusable engineering practices. Establish lightweight patterns for frameworks, CI/CD, test reporting and governance; coach teams to apply them rather than create a central delivery bottleneck.
  • Develop engineering capability. Pair with testers and developers across projects, review implementations, mentor senior engineers and build practical training and adoption plans.
  • Influence senior stakeholders. Explain quality risks, investment choices, technical trade-offs and transformation progress to engineering leaders, delivery managers and client decision-makers.
  • Own outcomes across teams. Measure adoption and results across projects, including regression effort, test stability, independent data setup, AI effectiveness, feedback speed and release confidence.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Multi-team enterprise transformation. Has personally led substantial testing improvements across several teams, applications or workstreams in an enterprise environment, with clear evidence of adoption and delivery outcomes.
  • Recent hands-on engineering. Strong coding, debugging and automation skills, including direct work on production test suites in C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java or equivalent.
  • AI implementation and adoption. Implemented AI-assisted testing on real enterprise projects and helped other engineers adopt it; can demonstrate verified test/data generation, practical safeguards and measured results.
  • Complex test data engineering. Has personally built reusable, isolated test datasets and shared patterns for relational or integrated systems using SQL, APIs, fixtures and builders; manages integrity, synthetic/masked data and reset.
  • Automation architecture and standards. Able to set sensible patterns across UI, API, integration, contract, data and regression tests, review designs and balance reuse with project-specific needs.
  • Microsoft-based environments. Practical experience testing .NET, SQL Server and/or Azure applications, including Azure DevOps or equivalent pipelines, Git and engineering workflows.
  • Tooling and delivery integration. Broad experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalents, plus CI/CD integration, test environments and flaky-test diagnosis.
  • Cross-project change leadership. Has built practical roadmaps, gained support across teams and delivered improvements incrementally despite competing deadlines and legacy constraints.
  • Executive communication and coaching. Can influence engineering and business leaders without formal authority, explain investment and quality trade-offs, and develop engineers through pairing and mentoring.

Desirable Experience

  • Regulated enterprise environments. Insurance, healthcare, financial services or other controlled industries, with experience of auditability, privacy and sensitive test data.
  • Advanced AI quality practices. AI-assisted test-suite maintenance, agentic testing workflows, LLM evaluation, repeatable AI-feature test datasets or governance for AI testing tools.
  • Specialist testing. Performance/load, security, accessibility (WCAG), API contracts, complex integrations or data-heavy application testing.
  • Broader platforms and consultancy. Cloud-native, distributed, legacy or mobile systems; multi-client consulting, reusable accelerators or relevant testing and Azure certifications.

Personal Profile

You are a credible technical leader who still enjoys writing code and testing software. You can see patterns across different client environments without imposing unnecessary process. You solve difficult automation and data problems yourself, mentor others patiently and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. You are realistic about AI, security and the pressure of live delivery.

What Success Looks Like

Multiple client teams adopt reliable automation, independent test data and verified AI-assisted testing practices that fit their delivery needs. Reusable approaches reduce duplicated effort, engineers gain confidence and the improvements are sustained beyond a single project. Progress is visible in adoption, feedback speed, test stability and release confidence, alongside dependable hands-on client delivery.

title: Stop Loss Claim Auditor
description:
Vālenz Health® is the destination for employers, brokers, payers, and providers to reduce costs, improve quality, and elevate the healthcare experience. Through advanced technology and clinical expertise, Valenz creates a distinctly different approach to a complex healthcare system. With our solutions, we execute across the entire healthcare journey — from member experience to payment integrity, provider quality, and plan performance. With one of America’s largest cost, quality and utilization datasets, we create greater transparency, flexibility, and cost containment — empowering members and employers with the information they need to make smarter, more cost-effective decisions.

About This Opportunity:
As a Stop Loss Claim Auditor, you’ll review and audit stop loss reimbursement requests to ensure accurate and timely payments in accordance with plan documents, stop loss policies, contractual requirements, and established procedures. You’ll evaluate supporting claim and eligibility documentation, perform aggregate claim calculations within your delegated authority, and help ensure reimbursement requests meet applicable requirements. You’ll also support plan document reviews, payment integrity initiatives, reporting, and high-cost claim monitoring to promote accuracy, consistency, and compliance throughout the stop loss reimbursement process.


Things You’ll Do Here:

  • Review and audits stop loss reimbursement requests to ensure accurate and timely payment in accordance with plan documents, stop loss policies, contractual requirements, and established procedures.
  • Evaluate supporting claim and eligibility documentation, performs aggregate claim calculations within delegated authority, and supports plan-document review, payment integrity, reporting, and high-cost claim monitoring.
  • Retrieve, log, organize, and review stop loss claim submissions and supporting documentation within established turnaround standards.
  • Audit initial and supplemental reimbursement requests for eligibility, covered expenses, contract terms, deductible application, and other applicable plan and policy provisions.
  • Perform preliminary calculations and audits for aggregate accommodations and final year-end aggregate claim submissions, including review of contract terms, aggregate factors and deductibles, enrollment and premium information, paid claim data, and supporting documentation.
  • Identifie discrepancies, exceptions, ambiguous contract language, and matters outside delegated authority and escalates them to appropriate Claims, Compliance, Underwriting, or leadership resources.
  • Obtain and evaluate supporting documentation, including eligibility records, extension-of-benefits information, FMLA and COBRA documentation, precertification information, accident or subrogation records, UB-04s, itemized bills, and other required materials.
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of audit activity, information requests, calculations, determinations, and supporting records within applicable claim systems.
  • Review plan documents, Summary Plan Descriptions, amendments, and related materials using established checklists and approved automated or AI-assisted tools.
  • Validate automated or AI-assisted review outputs before use in claim or plan-document decisions and escalates material discrepancies or uncertainties for additional review.
  • Identify potential eligibility, coordination, cost-containment, payment-integrity, or reimbursement issues and coordinates with appropriate internal and external partners.
  • Support high-cost claim monitoring, reserve and notification review, and related reporting by evaluating available clinical and financial information.
  • Communicate with TPAs, brokers, carriers, auditors, vendors, and internal partners regarding missing documentation, claim status, audit findings, and related questions within established authority.
  • Support claims quality reviews, reporting, research, procedure documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide backup support for claims intake and workflow activities as business needs require.
  • Perform duties in accordance with established procedures, contractual requirements, delegated authority, confidentiality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare claims, stop loss claims, medical claim auditing, TPA operations, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of self-funded medical plans, employer stop loss terminology, reimbursement processes, contracts, and operational workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret plan documents, stop loss policies, eligibility information, and claim documentation.
  • Strong analytical and mathematical skills with the ability to perform detailed claim audits and reimbursement calculations accurately.
  • Strong attention to detail with demonstrated ability to maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Ability to independently review claims within established procedures and delegated authority and appropriately escalate exceptions or high-risk matters.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple claims, deadlines, and documentation requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with TPAs, carriers, brokers, vendors, and internal partners.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word, and the ability to learn stop loss administration, underwriting, and reporting systems.
  • Ability to use approved automated and AI-assisted tools responsibly while maintaining appropriate human review and validation of outputs.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial, claim, and member information with discretion.

A plus if you have…
  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Accounting, Finance, Insurance, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience auditing complex or high-dollar medical claims.
  • Experience reviewing Summary Plan Descriptions, plan documents, stop loss contracts, or amendments.
  • Experience with aggregate accommodation and year-end aggregate claim calculations.
  • Experience with self-funded employers, stop loss carriers, TPAs, managing general underwriters, or related healthcare financing organizations.
  • Experience identifying payment-integrity, cost-containment, subrogation, coordination-of-benefits, or eligibility issues.
  • Experience with stop loss claims administration, underwriting, or reporting platforms.


Where You’ll Work: This is a fully remote position, and we’ll provide all the necessary equipment!

Why You'll Love Working Here

Our mission is to advance healthcare through technology and expertise to optimize cost, quality, access, and utilization for all. description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Enterprise Effects Division (EED) drives integration of Aerospace’s strategic capabilities across the national space enterprise. The division leverages a broad array of engineering disciplines against a wide-ranging and dynamic portfolio of programs, customers, and national challenges. EED spans the capability lifecycle from concept and architecture design to performance assessment to application of space and space-enabled capabilities. 

The Architecture Concepts Department (ArCon) provides expertise in architecture methods, processes, and tools to an extremely broad range of customers, including National Space Security (NSS) and other defense programs, NASA, NOAA, NNSA, DHS, and others.  ArCon staff participate in and lead architecture trade studies, architecture conceptualization studies, architecture modeling tasks, and program assessment analyses at multiple levels of complexity, ranging from prototype systems to full scale acquisition systems in the space, ground, communications, and network domains.  ArCon applies disciplined system architecting principles and leads cross-functional teams to provide impactful guidance to assist our customers in making key acquisition and operations decisions. 

Work Model: This is a part-time position (20 hours/week) performed fully remote. Occasional on-site presence may be required to support in-person Concurrent Design Center (CDC) sessions, as needed.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead space architecture trade studies and conceptualization efforts of medium to high complexity, assembling and leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams to address problem framing, gap analysis, and trade space assessment
  • Serve as a critical node and spokesperson for communicating technical needs and deliverables to project team members, program office, and customers; identify and facilitate access to subject matter expertise across the corporation
  • Evaluate, select, and apply system architecting methods, processes, and tools in a broad range of space architecture-level assessment, modeling, analysis, and conceptual design activities
  • Use, develop, and integrate analytical methods and tools to evaluate space architectural concepts and system conceptual designs for cost, schedule, performance, risk, resilience to disruptive events or threats, and other characteristics
  • Work with Aerospace program office, customer, and contractor personnel to elicit and identify needs, requirements, and constraints for studies; scope, plan, and execute studies; and effectively communicate task status, methods, results, and recommendations in briefings and formal technical reports
  • Manage project plans, resources, budgets, risks, and constraints to deliver impactful and timely products within a part-time schedule, prioritizing and sequencing work to meet study milestones
  • Collaborate with other Aerospace personnel to marshal technical expertise in multiple technical disciplines and domains to enable concurrent engineering approaches to address complex space architecture problems
  • Mentor and train junior staff for effective task execution on space architecture studies

What You Need to be Successful

Minimum Requirements for Project Lead:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in engineering, science, or related technical field
  • At least 8 years of professional experience in engineering, may be satisfied by combinations of MS Degree, PhD, and/or professional experience
  • Experience in space system or enterprise architecting, systems engineering, concept design, and/or model-based systems engineering
  • Experience organizing and leading cross-functional, cross-organizational teams to execute projects or studies, including as Project Lead or Systems Lead on a study team
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to present methods and results effectively in briefings, formal reports, and informal communications
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with teams, customers, Aerospace program offices, and contractors, and to collaborate with other functional organizations within Aerospace
  • Demonstrated ability to manage time and deliverables independently in a part-time, remote work arrangement, including proactive communication with team members and customers across differing schedules
  • Available and willing to travel to an Aerospace campus (Chantilly, VA; Colorado Springs, CO; or El Segundo, CA) as needed to support in-person CDC sessions

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these:

  • Master's and/or Ph.D. in engineering, math, science, or related technical discipline
  • Demonstrated initiative to innovate, shape, drive, and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of tasks, projects, or organizations
  • Demonstrated success in organizing and leading cross-functional, cross-organizational teams to execute studies and assessments and generate quality products
  • Relevant work and/or graduate school experience in system or enterprise architecting, systems engineering, model-based systems engineering, or digital engineering
  • Experience with spacecraft, payloads, ground systems, launch systems, missile systems, nuclear weapon systems, and/or aircraft systems
  • Hands-on experience with system or enterprise modeling in the Systems Modeling Language (SysML), Unified Architecture Framework (UAF), or Unified Profile for DoDAF and MODAF (UPDM)
  • Experience working closely with key Aerospace customer agencies in the defense and intelligence community, including strong knowledge of their domain and strong professional networks
  • Prior experience successfully executing a part-time or remote technical role, including proactively structuring one's own schedule to meet project deadlines

In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications—leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS).

You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

  • 5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model).

  • Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance.

  • Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations.

  • Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations.

  • Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

  • Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM).

 

Nice-to-have skills:

 

  • Hands-on experience developing side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP using Node.js/CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or ABAP Cloud.

  • Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects.

  • Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations.

  • Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP).

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Architect, build, and maintain high-performing transactional and analytical SAP applications using ABAP RAP, CDS views, and AMDP.

title: New Business Manager
description:
Our company

Surfer is an AI Visibility Platform that helps marketing teams become the definitive answer wherever their buyers search — across Google and AI search. The platform combines data, research-backed optimization, and a user-friendly workflow to grow brand visibility through content where buying decisions start to form.

Surfer is used by content marketers, SEO specialists, agencies, and in-house marketing teams around the world to track, plan, write, and optimize content that gets ranked and cited by both search engines and LLMs.

Surfer is part of Positive Group - a fast-growing tech group specializing in B2B SaaS products that help marketing teams grow smarter. The group brings together several brands around a common ambition: to become the European benchmark in MarTech. With around 400 employees based in France, Germany, Italy, and Poland, Positive supports customers in 80+ countries.

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland where the magic happens (and coffee never runs out ☕).


About the role

We're looking for someone who's worked at a marketing/SEO agency or a martech company and knows what it takes to close - someone who picks up the phone without thinking twice, and who hasn't been trained out of that instinct by years of "process."

On a day-to-day basis, you'll own the new-business side end-to-end: prospecting and building your own pipeline, working the leads that come your way, qualifying them, running discovery and demos, negotiating, and closing. You'll work closely with the Customer Success team, and get support from Marketing and RevOps. This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn.

You will be responsible for:

  • Work both sides of the pipeline: reaching out to existing leads in our CRM (conference, meetup, webinar, and community signals plus records of past interest) while building a new pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting.

  • Prospect actively: research target accounts, identify decision-makers, and open conversations with agencies and in-house teams that haven’t reached out to us yet.

  • Run multi-channel outreach on these leads across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Build and continuously refine ICP-aligned contact lists covering both marketing/SEO agencies and in-house SEO/marketing teams at companies.

  • Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 4 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency, a martech company (e.g. SEO, content, analytics, or marketing automation software), or at a company selling into agencies.

  • Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting.

  • Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs).

  • No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing.

  • Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that.

  • Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools.

  • Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above).

  • Nice to have: experience selling a SaaS product (not a service); ABM (account-based marketing/sales) experience.

What we offer:

We build the team around experts and stay out of their way. That starts with the basics:

Compensation: $36,000–45,500/year base (excl. VAT, where applicable), plus a bonus system.

Contract: We work exclusively on B2B (contractor) agreements. This means you’ll need your own registered business (e.g. sole proprietorship / self-employed status in your country) and will invoice us monthly.

We take care of the things that matter outside the work itself - your health, your rest, the setup that lets you work well, and the chance to sharpen your craft. Everything else follows from how we operate: trust over control, outcomes over hours.

Location and Remote Work:

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław, Poland.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Video Creator (100% remote)
location: USA, Canada, Ireland or UK only
description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no social following required!

Hello! We’d love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Spirit Halloween, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker
